notes.notes:
Would like to thank everyone for their feedback and I hope you like the improvement!

This is a live update. Please exit the game and update your client (restart your Steam client if you're not seeing the update). We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128839/7f1cecca3dd453cbc82d13eae59bf8a0be8f79b4.png[/img]

Improvements

- Craft System;

You can create different items depending on the type and each of them requires gold and 3 items of each item required for its creation. Create a superior item if you roll 70+, receiving a +25% bonus to your base stats, a normal item is 50+ and receives no bonus. If you don't get better results, you will create a lower quality item and receive a -25% penalty to your item's base stats. You can increase your crafting chance by using a Lucky Gem.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128839/6c77c3feb79f51343ed52a2d09dd07f1ce2f213b.png[/img]

Improvements

- Reforge System;

You can reforge your legendary equipment to become a powerful epic version! Even if you fail rolling below 50, you will not lose your legendary item, only the materials will be consumed. You can increase your crafting chance by using a Lucky Gem.

Adventurers,

Today marks a huge milestone in our shared journey. Since the early access launch, your passion, dedication and support have been the force behind our development. Without your wishlists, followers, and feedback, we wouldn't be where we are today. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you.


Join our discord and share your experiences with Devs and other players!

[url=https://discord.gg/qSqWvhY723] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128839/eb194386f98e13d16a6346870fdb16a2a8313be1.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Enjoy an exclusive guardian companion and special items for those who participate in early access [/h3]

Early Access players will participate in the pre-season receiving several benefits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128839/6a40c3a505d0fccb68efebb897b40b754c327d31.png[/img]

Of course, improvements couldn't be missed based on the feedback from all of you!

[list]
*Screen improvement;
*Exploration and Combativeness;
*Increased enemy drop chance, improving the game's grinding;
[/list]

[b]In the adventure it is now possible to advance and finish the exploration, making the grinding easier;
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128839/584aff20914520ee85e37114219957299db88835.png[/img]

[i]Small bug fixes and the problem where anyone who presses to attack repeatedly quickly consumes action points and does not make the attack.[/i]
